violations.reason: The user stated in step 2 that they already flew the outbound flights, and the reservation details in step 7 show the outbound flight HAT031 was dated 2024-05-11 before the current date. Despite this, the agent asserted eligibility in step 8 and called cancel_reservation in step 11, whereas the policy requires the agent to not help and to transfer the user when any portion of the flight has already been flown.
